# Autumn Trails Veterinary Center

> A full-service animal hospital in Charlottesville, VA offering urgent care, wellness exams, dental services, boarding, and pet food delivery.

Autumn Trails Veterinary Center is a comprehensive veterinary facility serving the Charlottesville area with extended hours and same-day urgent care appointments. The practice is led by Dr. Jennifer Cardoza and Dr. Gerbus, and provides preventive care, emergency services, professional boarding, and convenient online pet food ordering through Covetrus Pharmacy.

## Key Topics

- Urgent Care
- General Wellness
- Dental Care
- Boarding Services

## Core Services

- [Services Overview](https://autumntrailsvet.com/pet-care-services): Main services overview including wellness, dental, urgent, and emergency pet care.
- [General Wellness](https://autumntrailsvet.com/general-wellness): General wellness services with preventive care, exams, vaccinations, and parasite prevention.
- [Urgent Care](https://autumntrailsvet.com/urgent-care): Urgent care services for sick or injured pets with same-day appointments.
- [Dental Care](https://autumntrailsvet.com/dental-care): Dental care services including cleanings and periodontal disease treatment.
- [Boarding Services](https://autumntrailsvet.com/boarding-services): Premium boarding for dogs and cats with vaccination requirements and medical care.

## Pet Pharmacy & Food

- [Order Pet Food](https://autumntrailsvet.com/order-food): Pet food ordering through Covetrus Pharmacy with 30% discount on first order.
- [Hills to Home Delivery](https://autumntrailsvet.com/hills-to-home-delivery): Pet food delivery service with 30% first-order discount through Covetrus.

## Client Forms & Documentation

- [Forms](https://autumntrailsvet.com/forms): PDF and online forms for new clients, boarding, and veterinary disclosures.
- [New Client Form](https://autumntrailsvet.com/forms/new-client-form): New client intake form with pet registration and payment information.
- [Boarding Policy Agreement](https://autumntrailsvet.com/forms/boarding-policy-agreement): Boarding agreement with vaccination and medication administration requirements.
- [Veterinary Disclosure Form](https://autumntrailsvet.com/forms/veterinary-disclosure-form): Virginia-required veterinary disclosure form for staffing and hours.
